$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the captured pipeline with continue-on-error on both evaluation steps. The exit of `tea-evaluate` is the verdict, so a step that cannot fail the job turns every blocking class into a pass.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean and every element is present. Both steps that invoke a tea-evaluate command carry continue-on-error: true, which the rule that a gate must be able to fail forbids, so the result carries two rule violations and no element misses.

ruleViolations: continue-on-error: on a step that runs an evaluation check in job evaluation-pr step 4
continue-on-error: on a step that runs an evaluation check in job evaluation-pr step 5
